page.layout: One printed page, title page, one column of centred lines; a library stamp sits at the right beside the lines and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Caroli Mariæ de Veïl, S. T P.
Zephirinus Papa Epist. ad Episcopos Sicilienses apud Grat. dist. 38.
Sicut stellas Cœli non extinguit nox, sic mentes fidelium & inhærentes firmamento S. Scripturæ non obscurat mundana iniquitas.
Typis T. H. Impensis S. Carr, ad insigne Capitis Regis in Coemetrio D. Pauli, 1679.

page.notes: The stamp in the right margin ("CANT. ACAD.") is a library stamp and is omitted. The line "Typis T. H. Impensis S. Carr" is partly damaged; "Impensis" reads as "Impensis" with the start of the word worn. The line beginning "Zephirinus" is set in smaller type and is treated as lines of the title page.
